title: Rescaled area formula for blow-ups of a Lipschitz image
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous, B ⊆ ℝ^n Borel, and J : ℝ^n → ℝ Borel with J ≥ 0. Write H^n = μHE[n] and λ for Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n. Assume the weighted area formula ∫⁻_{F(B)} g dH^n = ∫⁻_B ofReal(J(x))·g(F(x)) dλ(x) holds for every g : ℝ^P → [0,∞]. Let b ∈ ℝ^n, r > 0 and f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous. Then ∫_{η_{F(b),r}(F(B))} f dH^n = ∫_{ℝ^n} 1_B(b + rc)·J(b + rc)·f(r^{-1}(F(b + rc) − F(b))) dλ(c), where η_{F(b),r} = blowUpMap (F b) r and 1_B·J = B.indicator J.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (r : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in F '' B, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (F x) ∂volume) → 0 < r → Continuous f → ∫ z in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (F b) r '' (F '' B), f z ∂μHE[n] = ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume
